title: Food Anxiety in Globalising Vietnam
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: Based on empirical research, this book focuses on the ambivalences and contraditions of eating in Vietnam. Against the background of an emerging consumer society and the globalisation of the agro-food system, eating becomes centre stage for people’s bodily integrity, social differentiation, identity projects as well as a lynchpin for national and international food policies.
